title: Cloud parity: ticfac run <epic> --cloud uses the same verbs, view and triage
description: ticfac run <epic> --cloud submits to the configured factory and attaches the same live view; the overview, triage and exit codes behave identically for cloud runs. Replaces the separate 'ticfac cloud run/status/logs' surface for everyday use (those stay as expert commands).
